claim_one_line: THE HALF BOUND (sealed e77f9b5b3; PROVED -- exact post-seal, machine precision in the run; four tolerance clauses failed as worded, a sealing error, disclosed): a Higgs in M couples by Y(a) = a R^T + R a^T - (a.R) 1, so the theta triplet R (isotropic by Jacobi) is always the massless state; for a real direction s1 s2 = |R|^2|a|^2 and s1^2 + s2^2 = 2|R|^2|a|^2 + |a.R|^2, so m = m2/m3 lies in [1/2, 1], set by one angle (1/2 in R's plane); m vanishes exactly on the isotropic cone a.a = 0 and grows linearly with |a.a|/|a|^2 -- the second-to-third hierarchy is the Higgs's isotropy defect. 0 of 19.
